# Synthetic video fixture

`slides.mp4` is a six-second H.264 video made for this project. It contains three
two-second slides with colored panels and geometric text placeholders. A red
handwriting line appears in the final second of each slide. It contains no
lecture footage, third-party slides, audio, or user notes. The project MIT license
applies to this fixture.

`letterbox.mp4` derives from the same synthetic video with 120-pixel black margins on both sides. It verifies black-boundary snapping and re-capturing an expanded crop from the original video. No personal lecture content is included.
